# Permissions MG4Dash and its modules (app, rescue, web, copytool, overlay) may declare.
# A manifest permission missing here fails CI. One full permission name per line, '#'
# starts a comment. Say why next to each group: this list is the reviewed answer to
# "what can these apps do to the car".

# --- Network: map, weather, lyrics, speed cameras, Home Assistant, updates ---
android.permission.INTERNET
android.permission.ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE
android.permission.ACCESS_WIFI_STATE

# --- Location: speed cameras, weather at the current position ---
android.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION
android.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION

# --- Phone, calls and Bluetooth (phone page, calls card, profiles linked to a phone) ---
android.permission.BLUETOOTH
android.permission.BLUETOOTH_CONNECT
android.permission.READ_PHONE_STATE
android.permission.CALL_PHONE
android.permission.READ_CALL_LOG
android.permission.READ_CONTACTS

# --- Media and audio: music card, sources, voice memos ---
android.permission.MEDIA_CONTENT_CONTROL
android.permission.MODIFY_AUDIO_SETTINGS
android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO

# --- USB stick: log export, settings backup, voice memos ---
android.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE
android.permission.WRITE_MEDIA_STORAGE
# Eject the USB stick from the log window (#106).
android.permission.MOUNT_UNMOUNT_FILESYSTEMS

# --- Home screen and overlays: start at boot, gestures over other apps, shortcuts menu ---
android.permission.RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED
android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE
android.permission.WAKE_LOCK
android.permission.SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW
android.permission.REORDER_TASKS
# The system-UID car app reaches the Web app module in the current Android user.
android.permission.INTERACT_ACROSS_USERS

# --- High risk: system-user capabilities (car build, platform signature) ---
# Brightness, ADB at start, the car's settings toggled from the shortcuts menu.
android.permission.WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS
# Exported logs (Settings › System) include other apps' lines.
android.permission.READ_LOGS
# Running apps window (Vehicle page): processes, open apps and memory.
android.permission.REAL_GET_TASKS
android.permission.DUMP
android.permission.PACKAGE_USAGE_STATS
# Maintenance mode: a touch at the very top handed back to the car's pull-down.
android.permission.INJECT_EVENTS
# Updates of MG4Dash, MG4Radio, MG4Link and the rescue app; their uninstall.
android.permission.INSTALL_PACKAGES
android.permission.DELETE_PACKAGES
# Maintenance mode, rescue: stops an app, chooses the home screen, switches components.
android.permission.FORCE_STOP_PACKAGES
android.permission.SET_PREFERRED_APPLICATIONS
android.permission.CHANGE_COMPONENT_ENABLED_STATE

# --- Signature-protected permissions between the project's own apps ---
# signature: MG4Dash talks to its Web app module.
app.mg4dash.web.permission.TALK
# signature (MG4Link): cut Android Auto from the shortcuts menu.
com.allgo.app.androidauto.permission.USER_DISCONNECT
